truncation.details: Broad rg filename listing was truncated by tool output limits. Returned warnings reported 1,213 total lines / 16,613 original tokens and another wrapper warning of 735 lines / 10,028 tokens. It was not relied on as a complete index.

Filtered event projection was truncated in the outer tool result (warning reported 10,405 original tokens; nested exec reported 9,155). It scanned all 4,804 index rows and identified 220 exact subject/cohort rows across 55 experiments. No decisive conclusion depends on omitted display output; semantic search and explicit linked-row retrieval were untruncated.

access_notes: Initial rg discovery traversed trial filenames broadly and displayed products/harbor-shop/history.json and products/catalog.json names. Neither file content was read; no other product information informed the decision. This filename enumeration exceeded the intended product-scoped discovery and is disclosed here.
No parent directories, generators, reviewer content, other trials, network services, communications, schedules or delegates were used.

actions.jsonl was fully scanned programmatically. Model-visible content consisted of three schema samples, a truncated projection of 220 checkout/mobile-returning rows, semantic matches, and four fully retrieved linked rows.
Only the four action-linked evidence JSON files were opened; no unrelated archive evidence contents were read.
The four decisive index rows omit cohort; cohort matching was verified in their evidence. The correction is under billing/payments-audit and directly points to the checkout observation.
Final write/validation command is included in this record; generated JSON and Markdown were read back locally for structural validation.
